tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Champagne Gold, the signature accent. Primary button fill, active nav indicator, selected rows, primary chart series, logo. Never a large background and never small text on light grounds (1.7:1 on ivory) — use `gold-ink` there.

tokens.name: gold-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of gold actions (primary button, gold toggles).

tokens.name: gold-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed/active state of gold actions.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold for text, icons and links. Light: darker gold #9C7B40 — 3.4:1 on `bg`, 3.9:1 on `surface`: meets 3:1 for icons, focus rings and text 24px+, NOT 4.5:1 for body-size text (source value kept). Dark: 9.4:1 on `bg`, 8.5:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `gold` fill (charcoal on gold, 9.2:1). Never white on gold.

tokens.name: gold-tint
tokens.usage: Selected tile/option background (Selector), behind a `gold-ink` border. Assumption: 14% gold over `surface` (light), 10% (dark).

tokens.name: on-gold-tint
tokens.usage: Label on `gold-tint`: charcoal text in light (14:1), gold in dark (7.0:1).

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Brand Charcoal. Dark logo ground, splash screen, structure in brand moments. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Brand Warm Ivory. Light logo ground and marketing backgrounds. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind sidebar, top bar and content.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, sidebar, top bar and inputs (containers).

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, popovers, table header rows and hover rows.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-elevated` (13:1+ light, 12:1+ dark).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, metadata. Dark: 6:1+ on every ground. Light: 3.7:1 on `bg`, 4.3:1 on `surface` — below 4.5:1 for small text (source value kept); prefer it on `surface` and at 13px+.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card outlines, table dividers, input borders. Light from source; dark value is an assumption (not in the guidelines).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline on every control, offset 2px. 3:1+ on all grounds in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status: in stock, completed, positive trend. Dot, icon, chart line or badge marker — always with a word or icon, never colour alone. As text it misses 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and low-stock states. Marker colour only; pair with the word ("Low stock") and the `warning` icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, out-of-stock, destructive actions (danger button fill with white text, 4.2:1 — bold 14px label), negative trend.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational states: incoming stock, pending, notices. Marker colour only.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 — gold, the primary series (this period, the series the story is about). Deeper than `gold` so marks hold on white; 2.8:1 on light `surface`, so light-mode charts carry direct labels or a table view.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 — blue. Assign series in fixed order 1→4; never reorder by rank.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 — magenta. Slots 1–3 are distinguishable in any combination (validated all-pairs, colour-blind safe), so line charts use at most these three.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 — indigo. Only for bars and donut segments, where it never touches `chart-2` (validated adjacent pairs incl. the donut's wrap-around).

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: De-emphasised data: the comparison period (last year) and the "Other" bucket. Series 5+ fold into it, never a new hue.

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-32

tokens.name: space-48

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Onboarding and splash layouts.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls: badges, checkboxes, chips, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs and buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: chips (currency, filters) and fully rounded tags.

shadow.note: Restrained: borders carry structure, shadows only lift. Values are an assumption — the guidelines ask for restraint but give none.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus and popovers.
